tools.name: border_wait_times
tools.description: Current wait to enter the US at a land border crossing: passenger car general lanes, SENTRI or NEXUS, Ready Lane, pedestrian and commercial truck (FAST) lanes, lanes open, port hours, CBP notices and when CBP last reported. Accepts a port or bridge name (San Ysidro, Otay Mesa, Peace Arch, Ambassador

tools.name: border_wait_times_list
tools.description: Wait times for one lane type at every CBP land port on the Mexican border, the Canadian border, or in one state (CA, AZ, NM, TX, WA, MT, ND, MN, MI, NY, VT, ME), sorted by the shortest wait or by name. Closed and pending lanes are listed after posted waits.

tools.name: border_fastest_crossing
tools.description: Rank border crossings by the current wait for a lane type and name the fastest. Pass crossings (e.g. ["San Ysidro", "Otay Mesa", "Tecate"]) or near (an area or state, e.g. "San Diego", "Juarez", "Niagara", "TX"). Drive time to each port is not included.
